description: Defines functions, structures, and macros for handling packetized stream communication, including reading, writing, and demultiplexing packet lines in a git-like protocol.

classes.name: packet_reader
classes.description: Encapsulates state for reading packetized lines from a file descriptor, including buffers, options, and status.

classes.name: packet_writer
classes.description: Encapsulates state for writing packetized lines to a file descriptor, including sideband usage.

methods.name: packet_reader_init
methods.description: Initializes a packet_reader structure with given parameters.

methods.name: packet_reader_read
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the packet stream, updating status and line info.

methods.name: packet_reader_peek
methods.description: Peeks at the next packet line without consuming it.

methods.name: packet_writer_init
methods.description: Initializes a packet_writer structure with a destination file descriptor.

methods.name: packet_writer_write
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet line to the output, dies on failure.

methods.name: packet_writer_error
methods.description: Writes an error packet line to the output, dies on failure.

methods.name: packet_writer_delim
methods.description: Writes a delimiter packet to the output.
